design_aid: geometry, power and cost of a finite-N test in which the side windows and order-only links of the five-window correction carry the reading; no measurement event drawn; continuum, post hoc and selection-only inputs

frozen_run_reweighted.note: centre_term_only is exact for these centre windows; primary_swapped and the Haar variant use the recorded windows' noise with the continuum signals of the new positions, so their spread (not their mean) is the finite-N input; identity_links_unswapped keeps the old positions' signals and only its mean is meaningful (random relative frames).

proposed_design.sized_for: 90% power of G1 in each scenario: kappa 1.2 at the continuum reading, and kappa 1 with the mean 0.01 above or below it

other_gates_at_2_25.note: F2 for one Haar draw; G3 uses the single-window spread for each side window's linked reading.

cost.model: generation 96 s per window at 2^25 (frozen run median, independent of the landmark count there), proportional to N; side-window fit 311 s x (clocks/6209)^1.63 with its clock-moment share (128 of 311 s) proportional to N; centre fit as measured (149 s, 85 s of it moments). Wall time per replicate: the larger of generation and fits / workers; the GPU is reserved for the whole wall time. The frozen run took 8.62 h for 64 replicates with 3 fit workers; this model gives 8.53 h.
